claim_being_audited: The current release may be certified now based on aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, prior family approval context, and a documentation/monitoring posture despite a current subgroup weakness.
specific_concerns: The policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or show approved mitigation; the summary does not establish that this predicate is satisfied.
The small-business onboarding slice is reported as 1.3 percentage points below the warning threshold, which is a current named subgroup weakness relevant to launch readiness.
The release record is described as containing only an informal monitoring comment, with no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot substitute for current-release support.
The actor's certification theory appears contingent on explicit current model-card disclosure, but that disclosure is not shown in the admissible record available to this role.
unsupported_claims: That the model can be certified now on the present record without showing explicit current model-card disclosure of the subgroup weakness or approved mitigation.
That prior family approval materially supports the current release despite the stated retrieval configuration change and new evaluation batch.
That an informal post-launch monitoring comment is enough to satisfy the policy requirement for disclosure or reviewed risk acceptance.
evidence_requests: The current release model card or certification document showing the current evaluation results, including the small-business onboarding slice.
The exact disclosure text for the material subgroup weakness, if it exists, in the current release documentation.
Any approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance record tied to the subgroup weakness, including reviewer/owner approval.
The release decision artifact that connects the current retrieval configuration to current evaluation evidence rather than prior approval context.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Certification is compliant only if material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by an approved mitigation.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient if a required disclosure/mitigation predicate is unresolved.
